+-- finch_admin is the Finch migration owner. Other owners' relations are out of scope.
+WITH finch_relations AS (
+    SELECT c.oid, c.relname, c.relkind, n.oid AS schema_oid, n.nspname
+    FROM pg_class c JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid = c.relnamespace
+    WHERE c.relkind IN ('r', 'p', 'v', 'm', 'f') AND c.relowner = 'finch_admin'::regrole
+      AND n.nspname !~ '^pg_' AND n.nspname <> 'information_schema'
+), app_relations AS (
+    SELECT * FROM finch_relations WHERE relname <> 'alembic_version'
+), migration_tables AS (
+    SELECT * FROM finch_relations WHERE relname = 'alembic_version' AND relkind IN ('r', 'p')
+), required_sequence_oids AS (
+    -- Follow defaults, including nextval() of a sequence without OWNED BY.
+    SELECT d.refobjid AS oid
+    FROM app_relations r JOIN pg_attrdef a ON a.adrelid = r.oid
+    JOIN pg_depend d ON d.classid = 'pg_attrdef'::regclass AND d.objid = a.oid
+                    AND d.refclassid = 'pg_class'::regclass
+    UNION
+    -- Identity sequences depend internally on the column, not on pg_attrdef.
+    SELECT d.objid
+    FROM app_relations r JOIN pg_depend d ON d.refobjid = r.oid AND d.refobjsubid > 0
+    WHERE d.classid = 'pg_class'::regclass AND d.refclassid = 'pg_class'::regclass
+      AND d.deptype = 'i'
+), app_sequences AS (
+    SELECT c.oid, c.relname, c.relowner, n.oid AS schema_oid, n.nspname
+    FROM required_sequence_oids r JOIN pg_class c ON c.oid = r.oid
+    JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid = c.relnamespace
+    WHERE c.relkind = 'S'
+)

+# Retry a lost/unavailable connection only. The grant transaction is safe to
+# replay, including when the connection dropped after the server committed it.
+reconcile_grants() {
+  {
+    cat <<'SQL'
+BEGIN;
+-- Alembic bookkeeping must remain readable when recreated by finch_admin.
+ALTER DEFAULT PRIVILEGES FOR ROLE finch_admin REVOKE INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE, TRUNCATE ON TABLES FROM finch_app;
+ALTER DEFAULT PRIVILEGES FOR ROLE finch_admin GRANT SELECT ON TABLES TO finch_app;
+ALTER DEFAULT PRIVILEGES FOR ROLE finch_admin REVOKE USAGE, SELECT ON SEQUENCES FROM finch_app;
+ALTER DEFAULT PRIVILEGES FOR ROLE finch_admin REVOKE USAGE ON SCHEMAS FROM finch_app;
+SQL
+    cat "$SCRIPT_DIR/app-relation-scope.sql" "$SCRIPT_DIR/reconcile-app-grants.sql"
+  } | PGCONNECT_TIMEOUT=5 "$PSQL" -X -w -p 6433 -d finch -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1
+}
+
+for delay in 1 2 0; do
+  if reconcile_grants; then
+    break
+  else
+    grant_status=$?
+  fi
+  # psql distinguishes connection failure (2) from SQL errors (3).
+  [[ "$grant_status" == 2 && "$delay" != 0 ]] || exit "$grant_status"
+  sleep "$delay"
+done

@@ -0,0 +1,22 @@
+SELECT format('REVOKE CREATE ON SCHEMA %I FROM PUBLIC, finch_app', nspname)
+FROM (SELECT 'public'::name AS nspname UNION SELECT nspname FROM finch_relations
+      UNION SELECT nspname FROM app_sequences WHERE relowner = 'finch_admin'::regrole) s
+UNION ALL
+SELECT format('GRANT USAGE ON SCHEMA %I TO finch_app', nspname)
+FROM (SELECT nspname FROM finch_relations
+      UNION SELECT nspname FROM app_sequences WHERE relowner = 'finch_admin'::regrole) s
+UNION ALL
+SELECT format('GRANT %s ON TABLE %I.%I TO finch_app',
+    CASE WHEN relkind IN ('v', 'm') THEN 'SELECT' ELSE 'SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE' END,
+    nspname, relname)
+FROM app_relations
+UNION ALL
+SELECT format('REVOKE INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE, TRUNCATE ON TABLE %I.%I FROM finch_app', nspname, relname)
+FROM migration_tables
+UNION ALL
+SELECT format('GRANT SELECT ON TABLE %I.%I TO finch_app', nspname, relname) FROM migration_tables
+UNION ALL
+SELECT format('GRANT USAGE, SELECT ON SEQUENCE %I.%I TO finch_app', nspname, relname)
+FROM app_sequences WHERE relowner = 'finch_admin'::regrole
+\gexec
+COMMIT;
